subject.name: Science
subject.examPattern: School-conducted annual exam, 3 h, 80 theory + 20 internal assessment (periodic 5, multiple assessment 5, portfolio 5, subject enrichment/practical 5); 'assessment scheme similar to the Class X Board examination'; ~50% competency-based questions. Question count assumed 39 (Class X Science pattern). Units: World of Living 27, Matter 25, Motion/Force/Work/Sound 23, Earth 5.
